guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：衛星地面站通訊鏈路
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Satellite ground-station communication links
guides.concept: 以衛星鏈路預算、都卜勒與接收窗口串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect satellite link budgets, doppler and contact windows through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「任務資料流」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：遙測、任務資料與指令具有不同權限和時限。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「軌道與可見性」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「EIRP」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：EIRP 結合發射功率、損耗與天線增益。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留頻率，只改斜距與傳播損失。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「接收 G/T」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「都卜勒移頻」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：視線向相對速度使接收頻率偏移。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定距離，只改視線向相對速度。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「取樣與同步」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「大氣損失」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：降雨與仰角的影響依頻率與條件改變。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較不同仰角的假想遮蔽與大氣損失。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「接觸排程」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「地面網路」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：地面回傳可成為衛星鏈路後端瓶頸。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬縮短接觸窗口對可傳資料量的影響。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「指令驗證」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「授權邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：本課僅分析公開模型，不發射或操作真實衛星。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬縮短接觸窗口對可傳資料量的影響。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「任務資料流」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around mission data flows, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Telemetry, mission data and commands have different permissions/deadlines. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat orbit and visibility as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around effective radiated power, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: EIRP combines transmitter power, losses and antenna gain. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat receive g/t as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around doppler shift, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Radial relative velocity shifts received frequency. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix range and vary radial relative velocity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat sampling and synchronization as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around atmospheric loss, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rain/elevation effects vary with frequency and conditions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synthetic blockage/atmospheric loss at different elevations. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat contact schedules as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around ground network, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Terrestrial backhaul may bottleneck the satellite downstream path. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reduced contact-window duration and transferable data. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat command authorization as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around authorization boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: This course analyzes public models without transmitting or operating satellites. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reduced contact-window duration and transferable data. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat mission data flows as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「交接切換」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「授權邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「授權邊界」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for station handoff. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for authorization boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for authorization boundaries. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.
pitfalls: 天線增益足夠就不需追蹤都卜勒。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: Sufficient antenna gain eliminates Doppler tracking needs. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
guides.scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

courses.overview: 由衛星鏈路預算、都卜勒與接收窗口連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect satellite link budgets, doppler and contact windows to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 低軌衛星網路路由
related.why: 可移植「任務資料流」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from mission data flows; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「任務資料流」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from mission data flows; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理衛星鏈路預算、都卜勒與接收窗口；「低軌衛星網路路由」主要處理時變拓撲、交遞與星間路由，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes satellite link budgets, doppler and contact windows; Low-Earth-orbit satellite-network routing emphasizes time-varying topology, handover and intersatellite routing. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「衛星地面站通訊鏈路」與「低軌衛星網路路由」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「接收 G/T」的對照方法至「接觸預測」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Satellite ground-station communication links and Low-Earth-orbit satellite-network routing flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from receive g/t to contact prediction, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.difference: 本課主要處理衛星鏈路預算、都卜勒與接收窗口；「深空延遲容忍網路」主要處理儲存攜帶轉送、接觸計畫與資料壽命，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes satellite link budgets, doppler and contact windows; Deep-space delay-tolerant networking emphasizes store-carry-forward, contact plans and data lifetime. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「衛星地面站通訊鏈路」與「深空延遲容忍網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「接收 G/T」的對照方法至「持久儲存」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Satellite ground-station communication links and Deep-space delay-tolerant networking flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from receive g/t to persistent storage, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
